from itertools import product

def generate_combinations(items, r):
    """
    Returns a list of all r-length tuples (with repetition) from items,
    where order matters and every position can independently take any element.
    """
    return list(product(items, repeat=r))

# Example usage matching the requested call style:
assert generate_combinations(["Red", "Green", "Blue"], 1) == [
    ('Red',), ('Green',), ('Blue',)
]

assert generate_combinations(["Red", "Green"], 2) == [
    ('Red', 'Red'), ('Red', 'Green'),
    ('Green', 'Red'), ('Green', 'Green')
]
